title: Discount is being applied twice.
root_cause: The discount is being applied twice because the `apply_discount` function in `python-service/app/services/payment_service.py` is being invoked both during order creation and payment calculation, leading to duplicate discount logic execution when both endpoints are called in sequence.

changes_made.change:

changes_made.rationale: The original tax calculation used integer truncation and incomplete logic, contributing to incorrect totals when discounts were applied multiple times. Fixing the tax calculation ensures correct post-discount tax application, preventing compounding inaccuracies. This change isolates the discount logic to a single execution point.
